One leg of the 240-volt power to the contactor line side.
Contactor load side feeds compressor common and capacitor…

Compressor start winding tied to capacitor HERM and start…

Discharge-temp switch in series to high-pressure switch.

“C” = Common everywhere — but a different wire each place.
